props.heading: Higgsfield proved the shape for cinematic media: a remote MCP any Claude user ca
props.body: No new app to install. You add a URL in Claude's settings, and your existing Claude interface gains access to the Medhavy corpus and tools. Same interface, new starting material.

props.heading: The pantry layer — four tools, returning data, not prose.
props.body: List what exists in the corpus for this topic. Retrieve a fact-checked claim set. Pull the exam bank for this unit. Surface the canonical video for this concept. The tools return structured data that your AI then assembles into the course you're building.

props.heading: One hard rule covering both layers: no corpus, no serving.
props.body: If you ask for a claim set on a topic that isn't in the verified corpus, the server returns empty rather than hallucinating one. The constraint is the quality guarantee — the server will not produce unverified material.

props.heading: The lane already exists.
props.body: Anthropic ships education connectors today — the Medhavy server is building in the lane Anthropic opened, not asking anyone to adopt a new paradigm. The connector pattern is already in Claude's settings menu. The infrastructure is there.

props.heading: Three tracks, rising friction.
props.body: A local server on your own machine — days of setup. A remote connector you host yourself — an afternoon. The Medhavy hosted connector — a URL in settings, under a minute. The distribution strategy is designed around track three.
